topic: Gas used to fill party balloons
core_question: Which noble gas is commonly used to fill balloons so they float? (secondary: Who holds the current women's world record in the 100 meters sprint?)
answer_summary: Correct answer is helium, a light noble gas used to make balloons float.; after the topic shift: The answer must name Florence Griffith-Joyner (Flo-Jo), who ran 10.49 seconds in 1988, as the current women's 100m world record holder.
persona: dramatic and exasperated; chatty and verbose
